title: Extension System & Capability Discovery
description:
Implement a Feature Collection Pattern (similar to ASP.NET Core HttpContext.Features) to solve feature fragmentation across providers. Enables type-safe capability discovery without polluting core interfaces.

## Goals
1. Discover which features a generic client instance supports
2. Access specialized features in a type-safe manner
3. Avoid polluting core interfaces (IChatCompletionClient, IEmbeddingClient) with provider-specific methods

## Architecture
- IFeatureCollection container with Get<T>/Set<T>
- IHasFeatures marker interface on all client interfaces
- Provider-specific feature interfaces (e.g. IImageEmbeddingFeature)

## Phases
- Phase 1: Core Infrastructure (IFeatureCollection, IHasFeatures, update interfaces)
- Phase 2: Feature Definitions (IImageEmbeddingFeature, future IToolCallingFeature, IJsonModeFeature)
- Phase 3: Provider Implementation (Cohere, Azure AI Inference image embeddings)
